author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
2026 was a BIG year for Middle-earth at Gen Con!  From the designated Middle-earth BOOTH by Asomdee to Magic: the Gathering The Hobbit taking over Lucas Oil Stadium, there was a ton of great fun to be had!

Featured games:
The Lord of the Rings Trick-taking Game
The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship
The Lord of the Rings: Circle of Conflict
7 Wonders Duel for Middle-earth
Magic: the Gathering The Hobbit
The One Ring RPG
The Lord of the Rings: King's Gambit

#gencon #lordoftherings #middleearth
title: Middle-earth at Gen Con 2026!
